ConnectionTest.title: ConnectionTest
ConnectionTest.description: Read-only connectivity probe document used on boot to verify Firestore reachability.

CastDevice.title: CastDevice
CastDevice.description: Live presence and remote-summon beacon for an open presentation screen or device.

appScope.description: Application namespace partition key for scoped discovery queries.

networkHash.description: Hashed public router identifier used to highlight devices on the same Wi-Fi.

deviceLabel.description: Human-readable OS and browser display label.

deviceType.description: Form factor classification of the screen.

mode.description: Current presentation role of this device.

roomId.description: Current room code associated with this device.

slideIndex.description: Zero-based index of the currently displayed slide.

summonRoomId.description: Target room code when remotely summoned by a presenter.

summonSlideIndex.description: Initial slide index requested by a remote summon.

summonSubStep.description: Initial sub-step index requested by a remote summon.

summonNonce.description: Unique command token triggering immediate transition to receiver screen mode.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last presence heartbeat or summon action.

CastRoom.title: CastRoom
CastRoom.description: Real-time synchronized presentation room state shared between presenter controls and receiver screens.

activePresenterId.description: Client ID of the active presenter controlling this room.

blackout.description: Whether receiver screens display the dark pause curtain.

pointerActive.description: Whether the live laser pointer is currently visible.

pointerX.description: Horizontal coordinate (0..1920) of the laser pointer.

pointerY.description: Vertical coordinate (0..1080) of the laser pointer.

pointerColor.description: Hex color of the laser pointer.

spotlightActive.description: Whether the focus spotlight mask is active.

spotlightX.description: Horizontal coordinate (0..1920) of the spotlight center.

spotlightY.description: Vertical coordinate (0..1080) of the spotlight center.

casteTier.description: Highlighted caste tier on Slide 04 (0 = none, 1..4 = tier).

timelineLens.description: Chart zoom lens mode on Slide 08.

timerRunning.description: Whether the presentation stopwatch is running.

timerElapsedMs.description: Accumulated elapsed milliseconds before the current run.

timerStartedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the current timer run started.

strokesSlideIndex.description: Slide index to which strokesCurrentSlide belongs.

strokesCurrentSlide.description: Bounded list of vector annotation strokes for the current slide.

noteKey.description: Step key (slideIndex:subStep) of the most recently edited speaker note.

noteText.description: Updated speaker note text for noteKey.

updatedBy.description: Client ID that issued the update.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the room state mutation.

CastDeck.title: CastDeck
CastDeck.description: Synchronized slide deck ordering, visibility flags, and custom slides for a presentation room.

slides.description: Ordered list of slide configuration objects (visibility, order, custom slide content).

updatedBy.description: Client ID that updated the deck.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the deck update.

/castDevices/{deviceId}.description: Active presentation screens available for remote cast discovery.

/castDecks/{roomId}.description: Synchronized custom slide deck configuration per room.
